The N in SNAP stands for nutrition. Taxpayer-funded nutrition assistance should actually support nutrition.

South Carolina is holding the line with the Healthy Food SC project, planned to start November 1st. It's a 2-year initiative designed to help SNAP recipients make healthier choices. The program will exclude candy, energy drinks, soft drinks, and sweetened beverages from SNAP-eligible purchases.

Make America Healthy Again.
